E.1514/2022 18/12/2025
The attached list is of the field numbers of the land surveyed for acquisition for the
Kumbalam-Thuravoor railway Track doubling project from Kodamthuruth, Thuravoor &
Kuthiathodu villages in Cherthala Taluk in Alappuzha District. Any complaints regarding the
survey should be submitted to the Special Tahsildar L.A. (Railway) Kayamkulam @ Alappuzha,
who is in charge of the survey work, within one month of the publication of this notice.
Field maps are also available on application against payment of fees as prescribed from time
to time.
